description: Deterministic signature fixture for the v0.5 `response` entry (§9.8) — §9.2's context with the mailbox destination in place of the callback binding. `payload_sha256` is computed exactly as §9.2 (SHA-256 of JCS({"response": <response|null>, "state": <state|null>}) — shared code path with the callback verifier). The §6 Response body is byte-for-byte unchanged and carries no `to`: the verifier RECONSTRUCTS `to` from its own presented drain identity (its agent.id + the session it presented), exactly as a §9.2 verifier reconstructs callback_url from its own endpoint. `id` is reconstructed from the delivered `in_reply_to` (always equal — both name the original message record); `resolved_at` is the Response's response.resolved_at (present here; see dp-015 for the absent case). Matches examples/entry-signatures-v0.5.md §2.
obligation: Reproduce header `v1` from JCS(response_signed_context) + HMAC-SHA256(test_key); recompute payload_sha256 from the delivered {response, state} (never trusting a transmitted digest); reconstruct `to` from the verifier's own drain identity and `id` from the received in_reply_to; dedup on (in_reply_to, resolution_id) — the same Response may also arrive via §8.2 pull or a §8.3 callback with the same resolution_id. Expected runner wiring (#26): mirror the dp-001 branch with the §9.8 response context builder — sign the fixture context, compare v1 + canonical_jcs, recompute the payload digest from `entry`'s response/state.
